reasons: The two answers are nearly the same text. Both correct the false premise at the start: 邮政法 第四十七条 covers universal-service mail only, while 第五十九条 and 第四十五条第二款 send express parcels to the civil law. Both cite 民法典 第八百三十二条 and 第四百九十六条, refuse the idea of accepting 54 yuan, and draft a polite reply asking for 3999 yuan plus the 18 yuan freight refund. They share the same gaps: the old article number 第二十七条, no 第四百九十七条 or 第五百零六条, no IMEI, no 12305, no 1-year or 30-day appeal limits, and no mention that going uninsured may reduce the award. The only real difference is that A paraphrases the 第四十五条第二款 text inside quotation marks and drops the words “的损失赔偿”. B quotes it accurately, which gives B a very slight edge on honesty and correctness.
